title: Annotation record (blind double annotation + adjudication)
description: One annotation pass over a target (a query family or a ledger entry). Supports blind double annotation of at least 20% of the dataset. Adjudication passes may only be created AFTER both independent labels are recorded, and must reference exactly two independent passes (§21.6). eval/schema.py enforces: adjudication.recorded_at > both referenced independent recorded_at; independent passes for a double-annotated target are blind. See RAZIEL_Master_Execution_Plan_v1.3.md §21.6.

pass_type.description: `independent` passes are recorded blind (annotator cannot see the other pass). `adjudication` reconciles two independent passes and is created only after both exist.

blind.description: True if the annotator could not see any other pass for this target. Independent passes in the double-annotation subset MUST be blind.

adjudicates.description: For pass_type=adjudication: exactly two independent annotation_ids being reconciled. Empty/absent for independent passes.

recorded_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the pass was recorded.

labels.description: The four agreement-bearing label groups measured for inter-annotator agreement (§21.6).

present_absent.description: Whether the queried event is present. Absent labels over a declared scope require full human review.
